**Please do not attach the file, a backup of it, or screenshots of its records.** The report holds counts and FileMaker's own names only. How to make it: [docs/compatibility-report.md](../../docs/compatibility-report.md).

Run this on your own computer, read what it prints, and paste it below if you are happy to share it. Nothing is sent for you.

```
tabularius compatibility-report YourFile.fmp12
```

**The report** (paste it here)

**What you expected, and what happened** in a few words ("opened, but the Data API call my web page makes failed")

**What kind of solution it is**, in general words ("a contacts file with portals and some scripts"), not its name or its customers

*Security problems: do not file them here. Follow the private route in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).*
